title: Universal Checkpointing: A Flexible and Efficient Distributed Checkpointing System for Large-Scale DNN Training with Reconfigurable Parallelism
problem: Existing DNN training systems tightly couple distributed checkpoints to specific model parallelism and hardware configurations, preventing efficient reconfiguration of parallelism strategies during training and adaptation to hardware failures or resource elasticity.
motivation: Large-scale DNN training needs to flexibly adapt to hardware failures and dynamic resource availability.
method: UCP decouples checkpoint structure from parallel training strategies and hardware configurations using an abstract checkpoint representation. A pattern-based reconfiguration pipeline automatically and efficiently maps checkpoint state to various parallelism strategies without full reconstruction.
key_novelty: Decoupling checkpoint structure from parallelism strategies and hardware configurations to enable flexible reconfiguration during training.
contributions: Universal checkpointing system supporting reconfiguration across diverse parallelism strategies
Pattern-based reconfiguration pipeline for efficient checkpoint state mapping
Support for broader range of parallelism strategies than existing solutions with negligible overhead
Deployment and validation on real LLM training workloads

metrics.other: negligible reconfiguration cost; supports broader set of parallelism strategies than existing systems
